optionalFutureScope.summary: Full editor rewrite, new graph framework, maintained full language packs and unrelated engine expansion.
Direct selected-text Google translation, embedded translator or paid translation service pending explicit external-content and cost choice.
Reusable reviewable stage and rule presets with collision and preservation safeguards.
Selective bulk or copy settings across stages with per-target preview and undo.

nonGoals.summary: No loader, Minecraft, Gradle or dependency upgrade solely for this feature; preserve current master pins.
No silent rewrite of existing admin configs, no ability capability removal, no automatic quest generation, no new hosting provider selection.

ownerDecisions.question: Defaults movement policy
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Generated default configurations and new stages leave essential movement unrestricted. Administrators can explicitly configure movement restrictions.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner explicitly requires this default while retaining optional administrator controls. Remove generated jump, sprint, swim, climb and elytra restrictions; newly created stages have no ability locks.

ownerDecisions.question: Optional configuration breadth
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Implement optional structure configuration, including numeric priorities, with compatible defaults and clear editor controls.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This configuration driven mod must let pack authors opt in without silently activating restrictions or replacing existing advanced facilities.

ownerDecisions.question: Publication endpoint
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Publish the new mod release and deliver the updated existing web editor.
ownerDecisions.rationale: A local build or queued upload is not the requested endpoint.

ownerDecisions.question: Release version and next-stage guide
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Release version 3.1.0 includes author-written unlock instructions, next steps and location guidance configured in the editor and shown in the in-game stages menu.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Authors explain unlocking, next actions and locations; players need those instructions in game.

ownerDecisions.question: Editor delivery target identified by the request and repository
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Update the existing mod-served web editor opened with /pstages editor and bundled in the 3.1.0 JAR. No separate public host is specified.
ownerDecisions.rationale: This is the identified existing implementation; no additional public website or provider is specified.

ownerDecisions.question: Runtime placement and teardown
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Use node-1 only for headless builds, tests and dedicated servers. Use the verified Linux laptop for actual clients and graphical checks with isolated prelaunch silence, exact per-application mute, private multiplayer and complete owned-resource cleanup. Disposable server eula=true is already authorized.
ownerDecisions.rationale: Runtime fidelity and host safety are mandatory evidence boundaries.

ownerDecisions.question: Editor help on hover
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Keep Stage name, Stage icon and Required stages as plain labels and place short explanations and examples in Minecraft style hover tooltips with equivalent keyboard access.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner wants discoverable help without permanently crowding the form. Validation and save feedback remain visible.

ownerDecisions.question: Advancement style guide access and configuration
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Preserve the existing advancement style stages screen, add top Stages and What to do next tabs and a dedicated guide key mapping, control guide availability from the main config, and omit pack creator attribution from the GUI.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner wants familiar navigation and optional guidance. IF-003 fixes the engineering defaults at enabled and an independently rebindable, initially unbound guide key, preserving the existing key convention.

ownerDecisions.question: Complete main settings in the editor
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Expose the main configuration through the existing Settings page, including the guide switch, with complete typed controls, contextual help and verified application.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner explicitly requests main config editing in the GUI. This clarifies DEC-008 to allow an administrator Main settings control while keeping guide availability out of individual stage forms and player menus.

ownerDecisions.question: Editable player menu preview and existing activation controls
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Provide an editable advancement style preview of supported stage display and guidance settings, with nearby editing and separate simulated visibility and ownership states. Reuse existing rule activation controls.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner proposes direct preview editing, hide and show settings, conditions and visibility before acquisition. This bounded design preserves existing acquisition and reward behavior. A new claim or activation mechanism remains FUT-005.

ownerDecisions.question: Translation-friendly help without a service dependency
ownerDecisions.selectedChoice: Provide a Translate editor help button with browser instructions and translation friendly labels and help. Leave direct external text translation optional.
ownerDecisions.rationale: The owner asks for easier translation. Native browser translation is user operated, browser dependent and requires no new mod service or paid API. The unresolved direct Google option remains FUT-002 rather than an assumed permission to send editor data.

externalPrerequisites.name: Existing laptop desktop, discrete GPU hardware, audio tools and private host access
required_evidence: SSH access, active Hyprland instance, RTX 5090 Laptop GPU inventory, wpctl and pactl observed. Actual candidate renderer, stream correlation, verified mute and joined-world checks are mandatory execution gates, not already verified.

externalPrerequisites.name: Existing mod-served web editor delivery
required_evidence: The repository serves Vite editor assets bundled in the mod. Build and package the new assets and verify /pstages editor using the published 3.1.0 JAR. No separately identified external deployment is required.

externalPrerequisites.name: Established CurseForge and Modrinth publication capability
required_evidence: Existing broker inspected mapped CurseForge 1460273 and Modrinth rY4mdP4Q successfully. Resolve stale candidate selection to the approved 3.1.0 artifact before a fresh preview. Use available broker operations and verify both public file metadata and downloaded hashes. Current broker help lacks inspect-file, so inspect accepted metadata through supported public read-only pages or broker returned metadata without inventing a command.

externalPrerequisites.name: Existing Brave extension connection for editor interaction
required_evidence: The existing laptop Brave extension connection was selected and inspected. Execution must prove actual editor controls and exact candidate behavior.

completionEndpoint: ProgressiveStages 3.1.0 is tested, integrated through checked master pull requests and signed phase tags, published on CurseForge and Modrinth with matching verified artifacts, and its updated mod-served web editor and in-game guide are verified from the released JAR. Documentation, wiki and issue 57 reflect the verified result.

goalCreator.mandatoryBoundary: CORE-REQ-001 through CORE-REQ-011 across all four contiguous phases, with the full release endpoint.
goalCreator.nextExecutableAction: P000-TASK-001, verify latest approved master, existing checkout state, owned resource boundaries, pins and phase prerequisites before implementation.
goalCreator.knownFailingChecks: No runtime or implementation checks ran during research. Observed coupled structure aggregation, active default movement locks and missing dedicated guide remain unimplemented target behavior.
goalCreator.requiredEvidenceGates: Parser/compiler/arbitration/default/editor/guide tests, complete help and translated edit preservation, main config coverage and transactional effective state proof, preview parity and zero side effect proof, real server events, actual Brave workflows, silent laptop multiplayer and guide evidence, bounded diagnostics and overhead, complete cleanup, checked PR integration, resulting master verification, signed tags, both accepted platform artifacts, hashes, released editor and guide, documentation and wiki convergence.
